Extracted mention descriptors locate subjects but must agree with the source. Explicit other/different people must not be merged. Different relationships alone do not prove different people: one person may occupy two roles. Different roles without explicit continuity or distinction require uncertain. Shared names or relationships alone do not establish continuity. Explicit corrections of the previous fact can establish continuity when no distinction is present. Anonymous recording speakers and numeric speaker labels never establish account ownership or cross-recording identity. Authenticated personal-text authorship does not identify quoted people. Use uncertain when continuity or distinction is not established. For same or different, quote exact supporting text from each side. Quotes are evidence, not proof by themselves; decide the relationship from their meaning. Do not output a confidence score.
